verdict.rationale: LangGraph supports defining custom tools/nodes as plain functions (community evidence confirms nodes can be arbitrary functions and custom tool handling logic is fully supported), and docs reference tool integration via MCPAdapter and multi-agent patterns, but there is no direct first-party example showing typed tool definitions in 'a few lines of code' with type annotations/schemas. missing for 10: a concrete short code snippet showing typed tool definition syntax, first-party docs on the @tool decorator or typed tool schema, independent confirmation of brevity/ease claims.
